dedupeResult: The active pull-request repository was searched for the three station names, canonical domains, dedicated submission addresses and the 95bFM submission path before creation. No existing music-submission-agent records were returned. Digital and physical variants for Radio One and Radio Control are consolidated into one opportunity per station; general staff addresses and 95bFM's protected footer contact are retained only as verification context rather than separate queue entries.
emailVerificationLevel: music@r1.co.nz and music@radiocontrol.org.nz were confirmed as purpose-specific Music Submissions addresses on their stations' official contact pages and checked for syntax, first-party domain alignment and role relevance. Radio One's other published staff addresses and Radio Control's manager, programme, production and volunteer addresses were not classified as substitute submission routes. 95bFM's footer contact uses an official Cloudflare-protected email path and was observed but not decoded. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probe was performed.
safety: No email, form, message or submission was sent; no track, download link, MP3, WAV, metadata, biography, one-sheet, contact phone number or physical media was supplied; no parcel or postage workflow was prepared; no protected email address was decoded; no CAPTCHA, login, session, cookie, anti-spam, anti-bot control or platform restriction was handled or bypassed; no advertising, membership, donation or payment workflow was started; no contact was guessed; and no SMTP/MX/deliverability probing was performed.
